answer_1.quote: Our in-context learning benchmark is a collection of 21 common datasets spanning 6 broad types of tasks... We include tasks from the financial domain because classic structured NLP tasks (classification, named entity recognition, extractive QA) are common in financial data analysis... For generation (G) datasets, the model generates a completion which is then parsed and compared to the ground truth answer.
models: base and instruct versions of LLMs listed in Table (e.g., Llama-2, Llama-3, Mistral-NeMo, Gemma-2, OLMo)
answer_1.outputs: Generations (completions for QA, sequences for NER, labels for classification, etc.)

answer_2.quote: Depending on the dataset, evaluation proceeds in one of three possible ways... For multiple choice (MC) datasets, we use the model to score each of the possible answers using likelihood and pick the highest ranking one... For generation (G) datasets, the model generates a completion which is then parsed and compared to the ground truth answer... Accuracy... Weighted F1... F1... String F1... Fin QA F1...
